timeline.summary: 14 May 2026: Navneet dispatched the NCLT-convened notice for a 15 June 2026 equity shareholder meeting to approve the demerger of wholly owned Indiannica Learning's publishing business into Navneet, with Indiannica's capital reduced to erase a ₹126.77 Cr reserves deficit.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4.3 Cr (-99.0% YoY), net profit ₹0.39 Cr (-99.2% YoY).
Navneet Education reported Q4 FY26 standalone revenue of ₹394 Cr and PAT of ₹25 Cr.
Dushyant AmitDate Buch, CFO, shared the earnings call recording for Q4 & FY2026 on 22nd May 2026 via navneet.com.
Navneet Education held its Q4 & FY26 earnings call, guiding for 15% publication growth driven by state curriculum changes.
Crisil Ratings reaffirmed the CRISIL A1+ rating on Navneet Education Limited's ₹300 Cr commercial paper and ₹2 Cr bank guarantee facilities.
